name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Calico Charbroiled Cheeseburger with Fries
whyItWorks: 1/3 lb charbroiled Angus chuck patty with melted cheddar cheese on a soft toasted bun with fries. Plain ordering makes this an easily digested theme park staple.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Calico Cheeseburger plain with ketchup only (hold lettuce, tomato, pickles, and raw onions).
